title: Foundations: Media Communications Data Types
summary: What media communications data types are and why shared schemas matter.
body:
Data types for publishing and messaging: articles, broadcasts, campaigns, and audience metrics.

Shared data types let every system in media communications exchange records without translation errors. This database defines the core entities — each with fields, types, a real example, and the standard it follows. Use the type-definition records to design, and the schema records to build.

title: ArticleRecord - Type Definition
summary: Field-level definition of ArticleRecord for media communications.
body:
ArticleRecord: One published article.

FIELDS:
- article_id (string): ID
- headline (string): Headline
- byline (string): Author
- published_at (datetime): ISO 8601
- section (string): Section
- word_count (number): Words
- url (string): URL

EXAMPLE:
{
 "article_id": "AR-88120",
 "headline": "City Approves Riverfront Plan",
 "byline": "J. Rivera",
 "published_at": "2026-06-01T08:00:00Z",
 "section": "Metro",
 "word_count": 640,
 "url": "https://example.news/riverfront"
}

STANDARD: News publishing practice. Every record of this type should carry these fields with these meanings — that consistency is what makes data interoperable across media communications systems.

# ArticleRecord: dataclass + validator
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

@dataclass
class Articlerecord:
    article_id: str = None  # ID
    headline: str = None  # Headline
    byline: str = None  # Author
    published_at: str = None  # ISO 8601
    section: str = None  # Section
    word_count: float = None  # Words
    url: str = None  # URL

REQUIRED = ["article_id", "headline", "byline", "published_at"]

def validate(rec: dict) -> list:
    errors = []
    for f in REQUIRED:
        if f not in rec or rec[f] is None:
            errors.append(f'missing: {f}')
    return errors

sample = {'article_id': 'AR-88120', 'headline': 'City Approves Riverfront Plan', 'byline': 'J. Rivera', 'published_at': '2026-06-01T08:00:00Z', 'section': 'Metro', 'word_count': 640, 'url': 'https://example.news/riverfront'}

print('record ok:', not validate(sample))
